trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Exporting a model containing torch.nn.functional.pad on a tensor with rank >= 3, where the 6-element pad tuple has non-zero padding on a non-last dimension, such as F.pad(x, [0, 0, 0, k, 0, 0]), especially when dynamic axes are used.

bug_oracle.description: ONNX Runtime output differs from the original PyTorch output after exporting a model containing F.pad.
bug_oracle.signal: Mismatch between PyTorch reference output and ONNX Runtime output when padding is applied to non-last dimensions.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary input tensor ranks and shapes, especially 3D, 4D, and 5D tensors, and generate pad tuples with non-zero padding on non-last dimensions.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct random tensors and wrap torch.nn.functional.pad in an nn.Module for export through torch.onnx.export.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Use pad tuples with length equal to 2 * tensor rank; set non-zero padding only in positions that do not correspond to the last dimension, for example [0, 0, 0, k, 0, 0] for rank 3; enable dynamic_axes for selected dimensions.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Execute the PyTorch module to obtain a reference output, export the module to ONNX, run the exported model with ONNX Runtime, and compare the results.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use the PyTorch model output as the reference result; flag any mismatch between PyTorch and ONNX Runtime outputs as an incorrect export.
